feeds.title: Industrial Complexx
feeds.description: Industrial Complexx is a music magazine, as well as a promotional service for labels and artists. It is an independent medium oriented to experimental electronics, industrial music, and elaborate techno.

feeds.title: Distorted Sound Magazine » Industrial Metal
feeds.description: For the lovers of industrial metal, Distorted Sound Magazine publishes news, reviews, updates on artists & new releases, and more. Since 2015, we have been committed to bringing you the best in rock, hardcore, metal and everything in-between through our website.

feeds.title: Electrowelt
feeds.description: Electrowelt OnLine Music Magazine & Radio Player was created in 2008, Covering the Dark Alternative in Greece, Germany, and the rest of Europe & USA.

feeds.title: Music You Need To Hear » Post-Industrial
feeds.description: Music You Need To Hear brings you music releases on Post-Industrial in this segment of the blog. Music You Need To Hear is a collection of music fans whose sole purpose in life is to recommend different music from all over the world to those of you who don't normally explore new sounds.

feeds.title: Elektro Vox
feeds.description: Elektro Vox is the place for all industrial and synthetic music news, reviews, and interviews. Read about events, band interviews from the world of industrial, EBM, and Goth music.

feeds.title: Transcended Music Blog » Industrial Metal
feeds.description: Transcended Music Blog shares articles, news, and reviews on Industrial Metal in the following segment. The entire Team TMB consists of friends who often meet - listen to and talk about music - go to concerts - discuss their latest vinyl collection adds. We are just a bunch of friends who expanded the idea of talking about music and put our passion for music into this blog.

feeds.title: Genre Is Dead! » Industrial Metal
feeds.description: Read articles, reviews, and more on Industrial Metal by the experts of Genre Is Dead! Genre Is Dead is a music magazine bringing you news, interviews, photos, reviews, and other fun stuff about all kinds of music.

feeds.title: The Noise Beneath The Snow
feeds.description: Noise Beneath the Snow blog specializes in reviews/interviews of underground noise, metal, EBM artists & labels. We strive To promote international artists in the genres of noise, neofolk, dark ambient and metal through the creation of thoroughly researched and well-written content.

feeds.title: NovaFuture Blog » Industrial
feeds.description: NovaFutire blog/magazine is mainly about music but also other forms of art like photography. The music part is not only about techno, it's about all kinds of music - all music we love. So the blog is run by (music) lovers that want to support artists, labels, DJs, photographers, artists etc. Browse through articles and promotion for music from the genre Synth-pop / EBM / Industrial.

feeds.title: Metal Odyssey » Industrial Metal
feeds.description: Welcome to Metal Odyssey, it will be quite the Metal trip! I revere Metal music, all genres of Metal music at that. I listen to Power Metal, Death Metal, Thrash Metal, Old School Heavy Metal, Metal, Extreme Metal, Christian Metal, Hair Metal/Glam Metal, Black Metal, Metalcore and any other Metal genre that has not been mentioned in this statement. Explore my take on industrial metal music genre in this section.

feeds.title: Bass and Space » Industrial
feeds.description: Find the latest industrial music releases, artists, albums and more on Bass and Space. Bass and space has been created as a navigation aid in the wide ocean of netlabel releases and creative commons music to support netlabels and their artists.

feeds.title: Synthbeat.com » Industrial Metal
feeds.description: Industrial electronic music ranges from dark and aggressive to more melodic. The variety of techniques ranges from sampling to musique concrete. Read about them here on Synthbeat. Synthbeat delivers news, interviews, and reviews of the coolest analog and digital electronic music, including synthpop, techno, darkwave, goth, and pop music.

feeds.title: Music Existence » Industrial Metal
feeds.description: Here discover the news and the best Industrial Metal music and artists. Music Existence exists because music exists. Our sole mission is to spread the word about great music to great music lovers. Stay tuned to find your next on-loop song.

feeds.title: Terminal 313 » Industrial Metal
feeds.description: in the following section of Terminal 313 read write-ups covering new songs and artists in the Industrial Metal genre. My name is Janno and I'm a seasoned techno nerd writing about old and new electronic music. Terminal 313 is not my job, this is my hobby, and I would like to have fun out of that - for anybody concerned.

feeds.title: Sounds and Shadows » Industrial Metal
feeds.description: Read music Reviews, Interviews, and more of the world's top Industrial Metal genre on Sounds and Shadows. We are musicians, fans, and just people passionate about sharing new music worldwide. Sounds and Shadows is a page dedicated to sharing the music and stories of all genres dark and intense.

feeds.title: Markus' Heavy Music Blog » Industrial Metal
feeds.description: I'm Markus and this is my blog, here you can read about Industrial Metal written by me. I started Markus' Heavy Music Blog back in 2013 with a first post. What you can read through on Markus' Heavy Music Blog is not more, but also not less, than my view on metal music when it comes to CDs, vinyl, live shows, and more.

feeds.title: Secuencia Densa » Industrial
feeds.description: Secuencia Densa is especially interested in new and unknown producers and DJs and the less commercial electronic styles. Check out industrial metal music, artists, reviews, news and more!

feeds.title: Music Matters Magazine » Industrial Music
feeds.description: Bringing you the latest in music news and concert coverage from the industrial metal industry. Music Matters Magazine is an editorial/pictorial site whose main purpose is to bring its friends, family and fans the latest information in the music industry, press releases, CD releases, tour information, live concert photo galleries and reviews.

feeds.title: Thy Kingdom Scvm » Harsh Noise
feeds.description: My name is Scvm. I'm just some bored, cranky, opinionated schmo with a computer and this is my outlet. I mainly talk about music here; I also occasionally talk about stuff beyond that, but It's mostly about music. I review albums, promote bands that I feel are deserving of recognition and talk about current happenings within the scene. Delve into my rants, reviews and ramblings about the harsh noise genre here.

feeds.title: Onyx Music Reviews » Industrial Techno
feeds.description: My name is Adele. Music has been a passion for my whole life fueled by my parents, and at 13 I became was later termed a 'goth'. Onyx Music Reviews endeavours to cover dark alternative music that you may or may not be familiar with: whether well-established or up-and-coming. Genres include gothic, post-punk, deathrock, darkwave, coldwave, new wave, synth, EBM, industrial, and some metal. I hope to bring you reviews of new music and bands from the industrial techno genre.

feeds.title: Freestyle Indulgence - the hottest new & classic freestyle dance music mixshow!
feeds.description: Freestyle Indulgence Mixshow' is your ultimate destination for cutting-edge dance music. Hosted by DJ Scott Durand, this club-style mixshow celebrates the best of freestyle, blending fresh new tracks with timeless classics from the '80s and '90s. Tune in for an electrifying journey through the beats that defined a generation and continue to inspire today's dance floors

feeds.title: EBM
feeds.description: EBM is a Greek non-profit music web portal about electro, EBM, gothic, new wave, noise and industrial music news, lyrics, artist interviews, reviews, releases and more.

feeds.title: Brutal Resonance
feeds.description: Started in the spring of 2009, Brutal Resonance is a music blog that quickly grew from a Swedish-based netzine into an established International zine of the highest standard. They cover genres like Synthpop, EBM, Industrial, Dark Ambient, Neofolk, Darkwave, Noise, and all their sub- and similar genres. The blog consists of music, songs, reviews, interviews, podcast and more.

feeds.title: AlterNation
feeds.description: AlterNation reliably presents the latest and most interesting news from the alt music world, to our users, otherwise, little known among small groups of fans - synthpop, futurepop, electro, power noise, industrial, gothic, along with a little mix of more commercially popular music like rock, metal, etc.
